Semantic intents (1)

modify Use TypeSpec-native metadata for Location-based LROs

The shared helpers replace raw OpenAPI long-running-operation extensions with Azure.Core.useFinalStateVia("location"), while operation declarations remove legacy polling links and related suppressions. The retained GET response contracts are unchanged; the change affects generated-client understanding of polling and final results.
